metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.
Unique identifier for the analytics rule.

properties.displayName: SQL-DB-usecase2 - SQL Database Backup or Restore Command Detected - SecurityEvent
properties.description: Detects SQL Server backup and restore-related T-SQL commands in the SecurityEvent table. The rule covers SQL Server Audit event 33205 and native SQL Server command result events 3014 and 3041. Enable the BACKUP_RESTORE_GROUP audit action group and write audit events to the Windows Security log for user attribution and broader command coverage.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventSourceName =~ "MSSQLSERVER" and EventID in (33205, 3014, 3041)
| extend RawEventData = tostring(EventData)
| extend ParsedEventData = trim(" ", replace_regex(replace_regex(RawEventData, @"<[^>]+>", " "), @"\s+", " "))
| extend RawSqlStatement = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<Statement>(.*?)</Statement>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)statement(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bstatement\s*[=:]\s*(.*?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData),
    ParsedEventData)
| extend SqlStatement = trim(" ", replace_regex(RawSqlStatement, @"\s+", " "))
| where SqlStatement matches regex @"(?i)\bBACKUP\s+(DATABASE|LOG|CERTIFICATE|MASTER\s+KEY|SERVICE\s+MASTER\s+KEY)\b|\bRESTORE\s+(DATABASE|LOG|MASTER\s+KEY|SERVICE\s+MASTER\s+KEY|HEADERONLY|FILELISTONLY|LABELONLY|VERIFYONLY|REWINDONLY)\b"
| extend CommandType = toupper(extract(@"(?i)\b((?:BACKUP|RESTORE)\s+(?:DATABASE|LOG|CERTIFICATE|MASTER\s+KEY|SERVICE\s+MASTER\s+KEY|HEADERONLY|FILELISTONLY|LABELONLY|VERIFYONLY|REWINDONLY))\b", 1, SqlStatement))
| extend DatabaseName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<DatabaseName>(.*?)</DatabaseName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)database_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bdatabase_name\s*[=:]\s*([^; ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\b(?:BACKUP|RESTORE)\s+(?:DATABASE|LOG)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.$-]+)", 1, SqlStatement))
| extend DatabaseUser = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ServerPrincipalName>(.*?)</ServerPrincipalName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<LoginName>(.*?)</LoginName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)server_principal_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bserver_principal_name\s*[=:]\s*([^; ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend SourceClient = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ClientIp>(.*?)</ClientIp>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)client_ip(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bclient_ip\s*[=:]\s*([^; ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend SourceIpAddress = extract(@"((?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}|[0-9A-Fa-f:]{2,})", 1, SourceClient), DatabaseHost = Computer
| project TimeGenerated, CommandType, SqlStatement, DatabaseName, DatabaseUser, DatabaseHost, SourceClient, SourceIpAddress, Computer, EventID, EventSourceName, Activity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: SQL {{CommandType}} activity was detected for database {{DatabaseName}} on host {{DatabaseHost}}. Review the SQL statement and available user context in the alert details and confirm that the operation was authorized.
